steps: HORSE (M4.2): 10 agents each fully execute a goal on varied free engines; results scored against your work-taste (M3.11b) and the best merged into one deliverable. Trigger: console /horse or 'EXCAVA: HORSE <goal>'. Runs on the CI beat; merged artifact lands in Results.

tutorials.title: START HERE — what EXCAVATORTRON actually is (the 5-minute mental model)

interactive.try: THE HUB is the product: ~8,000 real AI elements (skills, tools, prompts, models, connectors) mined from your video playlist and the web, verified and organized. Every other tab exists to grow, check, or use this.

EXCAVA is the company that runs it: every ~5 minutes in the cloud, a BEAT fires — tasks on the BUS get routed to DEPARTMENTS, agents talk and act, tools run, and everything commits back here. You're looking at its cockpit.

DEPARTMENTS are teams of named AGENTS (a lead, a doer, a checker) borrowing free AI engines as brains. Doing-departments act in 3 turns; thinking-departments (Self-Improvement, Power, Visualization, Accessibility) debate and decide. 🗣 = no real tool yet; ⛔ = blocked on you.

PROOF is how you trust it: every department's last real output, judged honestly (real / did-nothing / blocked), with the actual files openable right here. If it's not on this page, treat it as a rumor.
YOU are the boss: anything big, outward, or owner-only waits in this queue for your Review & decide. EXCAVA runs alone 24/7 — but it never goes over your head.

steps: The Hub = the product (8k verified AI elements)
EXCAVA = the cloud company that grows it (beat → bus → departments → agents → tools)
Rooms = watch the staff work; honest flags never pretend
Proof = trust, but verify — real outputs, openable in-app
The approval queue = nothing big happens without you
